_comment: Keys in each section are sorted alphabetically. Set "html": true on an entry to allow HTML tags in "text".

process_actions.title: Action
process_actions.text: Selects the operation to perform on the uploaded file(s). Different actions may show or hide inputs and options below.

action_details.assemble: Assemble HED annotations: creates a file containing the assembled HED string for each row in the tabular input file. The Append assembled option controls whether strings are added as a new column or returned separately. Other options control what is included in each string.
action_details.check_quality: Check HED quality: evaluates the quality and completeness of HED annotations beyond basic validity.
action_details.compare_schemas: Compare HED schemas: compares two HED schemas and reports differences between them.
action_details.convert_schema: Convert HED schema: converts a HED schema file between supported formats (e.g., XML to MediaWiki or vice versa).
action_details.extract_spreadsheet: Extract HED spreadsheet: extracts the HED portion of a JSON sidecar into a 4-column TSV spreadsheet with columns column_name, column_value, description, and HED for easier editing.
action_details.generate_sidecar: Generate JSON sidecar template: extracts a JSON sidecar template from the column structure of the events file. Use the column info table to select which columns are categorical (finite set of values) and which are value columns (numeric or free-text).
action_details.merge_spreadsheet: Merge HED spreadsheet: merges a 4-column HED spreadsheet back into a JSON sidecar.
action_details.remodel: Execute remodel script: restructures the events file using a list of operations defined in a JSON remodel file. Operations include renaming columns, factoring columns, and creating summary files.
action_details.search: Search HED annotations: filters rows using a HED query expression and returns a column of 0/1 match indicators showing which rows satisfy the query.
action_details.to_long: Convert to long: converts all HED tags in the file to long form — the full path from the root of the HED schema hierarchy (e.g., Sensory-event/Visual/Color/Red).
action_details.to_short: Convert to short: converts all HED tags in the file to short form — the leaf node only (e.g., Red).
action_details.validate: Validate: checks the uploaded files or strings for HED annotation errors. Enable Check warnings to also report non-critical issues such as deprecated tags. Enable Limit errors to truncate the error report for large files with many repeated errors.

definition_file.title: Definitions (.json)
definition_file.text: A JSON file containing external HED definitions to augment those of the other files. The format is a JSON dictionary with a single key definitions whose value is a list of HED definition strings. Each definition is of the form (Definition/Name, (HED tags)). The definition name must be unique across all definitions in the sidecar and definition files.

events_file.title: Tabular (.tsv) file
events_file.text:
A BIDS-style tabular file with a header line containing the column names.
  • Tabular files with an onset column are treated as timeline files.
  • Tabular files with no onset column are treated as descriptor files.
  • Values in the HED column must contain valid HED annotations
  • Accompanying sidecar and definition files contain HED information that applies across rows.
  • The value n/a is used for missing values.

query_input.title: HED query
query_input.text: A HED search expression used to filter rows. Rows where the assembled HED string satisfies the query receive a value of 1; others receive 0. Use logical operators (and, or, not) and wildcards. Example: Sensory-event and Visual-presentation

remodel_file.title: Remodel (.json)
remodel_file.text: A JSON file containing a list of operations on tabular files that can be applied in pipeline fashion using the Python table-remodeler package. Operations include renaming, factoring, and summarizing columns.

schema_file_option.title: Schema file
schema_file_option.text: Select this option to upload a local HED schema file in XML, MediaWiki, or JSON format.

schema_folder_option.title: Schema folder
schema_folder_option.text: Select this option to upload a schema in TSV format. TSV format consists of multiple TSV files in a folder named for the version.

schema_url_option.title: Schema URL
schema_url_option.text: Select this option to load a HED schema directly from a URL. The URL must point to a valid HED schema file in XML, MediaWiki, or JSON format.

second_schema_file_option.title: Second schema file
second_schema_file_option.text: Select this option to upload a second local HED schema file in XML, MediaWiki, or JSON format for comparison with the Source schema.

second_schema_folder_option.title: Second schema folder
second_schema_folder_option.text: Select this option to upload a folder containing a HED schema in TSV format for comparison with the Source schema. TSV format consists of multiple TSV files in a folder named for the version.

second_schema_url_option.title: Second schema URL
second_schema_url_option.text: Select this option to load the second HED schema from a URL for comparison with the Source schema.

sidecar_file.title: Sidecar (.json)
sidecar_file.text: A BIDS-style JSON sidecar that maps column values in the tabular file to HED annotation strings. HED definitions can be included in the sidecar to provide named, reusable tag groups.

spreadsheet_file.title: Spreadsheet
spreadsheet_file.text: A TSV or Excel spreadsheet file with columns containing HED to be validated. For Excel files, use the Worksheet name selector to choose the sheet to process. Once a spreadsheet is selected, you will be asked to select the columns that contain HED tags.

spreadsheet_4col.title: Spreadsheet (4 cols)
spreadsheet_4col.text: A TSV or Excel spreadsheet file with columns column_name, column_value, description, and HED. The spreadsheet represents the HED portion of a JSON sidecar and can be merged back into a sidecar using the Merge HED spreadsheet action. For Excel files, use the Worksheet name selector to choose the sheet to process.

string_input.title: HED string
string_input.text: Enter one or more HED strings to validate, convert, or search. Each line is treated as a separate string.

worksheet_name.title: Worksheet name
worksheet_name.text: For Excel spreadsheet files (.xlsx), select the worksheet to process. Only shown when an Excel file is uploaded.

include_prereleases.title: Include prereleases
include_prereleases.text: When on, the schema version list includes pre-release (beta/RC) versions. Use this to test annotations against an upcoming schema before it is officially released.

schema_path.title: Schema file to upload
schema_path.text: Upload a local HED schema file in XML, MediaWiki, or JSON format. Only needed when Other is selected in the schema version dropdown.

schema_version.title: HED schema version
schema_version.text: The HED schema version used for tag validation, assembly, and other operations. Choose Other to upload a local schema file instead.

append_assembled.title: Append assembled
append_assembled.text: When on, the returned file is a copy of the original tabular file with the assembled HED strings appended as a new HedAssembled column. When off, the returned file contains only the assembled HED strings, one per line (blank for rows with no HED).

check_for_warnings.title: Check warnings
check_for_warnings.text: When on, validation also reports HED warnings such as deprecated tags and style issues, in addition to errors.

expand_defs.title: Expand defs
expand_defs.text: When on, Def/XXX placeholder tags are expanded inline to Def-expand/XXX groups with the full definition body inside. See Replace defs if you prefer that definition tags replace Def/XXX entirely.

include_context.title: Include context
include_context.text: When on, each assembled HED string includes an Event-context tag group derived from temporally overlapping events. Tools use this information to determine everything happening at a given point in time.

include_description_tags.title: Include description
include_description_tags.text: When on, the contents XXXX of each description column are included as a Description/XXXX tag in the HED annotation generated for that row.

include_summaries.title: Include summaries
include_summaries.text: When on, summary files produced by remodel operations are included in the output as a zip archive alongside the remodeled events file.

limit_errors.title: Limit errors
limit_errors.text: When on, the error report is truncated to a manageable size. Useful for large files with many repeated errors of the same type.

replace_defs.title: Replace defs
replace_defs.text: When on, Def/XXX tags in the output are replaced with the full content of the definition they reference (without the Def-expand wrapper).

remove_types.title: No condition or task
remove_types.text: When on, Condition-variable or Task HED tags appearing at the top level of a HED annotation are stripped from the assembled HED strings. Internal tag groups containing these tags at their top level are also removed. This is useful for downstream analysis that does not need study-design tags.

save_merged.title: Save merged
save_merged.text: When on, partnered library schemas are saved with their full standard partner included in the output. When off, only the library schema and its direct parents in the standard partner are shown.

show_details.title: Show error details
show_details.text: When on, the full technical details of each error are shown. When off, a shorter summary message is displayed.
